fragments.text: Greetings, everyone I am Dr. Mukesh Mera from New Delhi India, it is an honor to be here today at the fifth Artificial Intelligence for Information Conference. I would like to extend my gratitude to the Organizing Committee for giving me this opportunity to discuss the profound role of AI playing in medicine. As a senior director at Mac Super Special Hospital Delhi, with over 36 years of medical practice, I have witnessed first hand the transformative impact of technology on healthcare, holding fellowships from Royal College of London, Glasgow and Edinburgh and American College of Physicians serving as an international examiner for MRCP UK Paces. I can truly appreciate the advancement that AI has brought to the field of medicine.
